senses.gloss: f. (<cite ref="J00627"><he>ירי</he></cite>, Af. <cite ref="A00875"><he>אוֹרִי</he></cite> = h. <cite ref="V00290"><he>תּוֹרָה</he></cite>)

units: Targ. Lev. VI, 7; a. fr.—מילה דא׳ (= דברי תורה) religious discourse, lesson, remarks &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 8:2:7">Y. B. Bath. VIII, 16ᵃ</cite> <he>אורייא</he>; Y. Taan. III, 66ᶜ bot. <he>ייתא …</he>—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:2:8">Y. Snh. I, 18ᶜ</cite> <he>אפלגינון במילי דא׳</he> he entertained them with religious discussions.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 3:1:2">Y. Hor. III, beg. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>עתיד לך מילה דא׳</he> be prepared for a religious discourse.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 3:2:7">Y. Shek. III, 47ᶜ</cite> top <he>מאי א׳ חדתא שמעת</he> what novel interpretation hast thou heard? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 2:6:5">Y. Yeb. II, 4ᵃ</cite> top <he>מן הדא אורייה</he> from what verse?—
<cite ref="Taanit 4a:15">Taan. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>ליה א׳ … מרתח׳</he> it is the zeal of study that makes him warm (excited).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 71b:3">Kidd. 71ᵇ</cite> <he>אורייתין כשר׳</he> my instruction is acceptable, but my daughters are not desired.
Sabb. 116ᵇ א׳ דמשה the Mosaic dispensation (opp. א׳ אחריתי the new dispensation, v. אָוֶון).—דְּאוֹרַיְיתָא (sub. הלכה = h. התורה מן) an enactment founded on the Bible text, opp. דרבנן.
Succ. 44ᵃ לולב דא׳ Lulab, the law concerning which is Biblical &c.; a. fr.—מִדְּאוֹרַיְיתָא, adv. biblically, according to the Biblical law, opp. מדרבנן.

senses.gloss: the Torah, the scroll containing the Pentateuch, used at divine service.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 7:1:5">Y. Yoma VII, 44ᵇ</cite> top <he>כד היא חדא אוריא</he> when you have no more than one scroll.

Y. Meg. IV, 75ᵇ bot.; Y. Sot. VII, end, 22ᵃ כד חזרא אורייה (corr. as Y. Yoma l. c.). Ib. תא וכ׳—תמן מייבלין א there (in Babylon) the Torah is carried to the Resh Galutha.—בר אוריא a scholar, man of learning.
<cite ref="Chagigah 14a">Ḥag. 14ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="A03093"><he>אריא</he></cite> (corr. acc.); v. <cite ref="A00889">next w.</cite>
